---
title: "Taylor Swift Album Colors"
---

Select an album below to compare its average color palette with all other albums.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
albums = [
  {id: "1989", title: "1989", r: 0.789, g: 0.743, b: 0.678, file: "data/swift/1989.jpg"},
  {id: "1989_taylors_version", title: "1989 (Taylor's Version)", r: 0.624, g: 0.629, b: 0.634, file: "data/swift/1989_taylors_version.jpg"},
  {id: "evermore", title: "Evermore", r: 0.500, g: 0.449, b: 0.423, file: "data/swift/evermore.jpg"},
  {id: "fearless", title: "Fearless", r: 0.824, g: 0.740, b: 0.611, file: "data/swift/fearless.jpg"},
  {id: "fearless_taylors_version", title: "Fearless (Taylor's Version)", r: 0.591, g: 0.470, b: 0.300, file: "data/swift/fearless_taylors_version.jpg"},
  {id: "folklore", title: "Folklore", r: 0.660, g: 0.660, b: 0.660, file: "data/swift/folklore.jpg"},
  {id: "lover", title: "Lover", r: 0.839, g: 0.742, b: 0.806, file: "data/swift/lover.jpg"},
  {id: "midnights", title: "Midnights", r: 0.641, g: 0.556, b: 0.557, file: "data/swift/midnights.jpg"},
  {id: "red", title: "Red", r: 0.396, g: 0.327, b: 0.336, file: "data/swift/red.jpg"},
  {id: "red_taylors_version", title: "Red (Taylor's Version)", r: 0.442, g: 0.321, b: 0.254, file: "data/swift/red_taylors_version.jpg"},
  {id: "reputation", title: "Reputation", r: 0.657, g: 0.657, b: 0.657, file: "data/swift/reputation.jpg"},
  {id: "speak_now", title: "Speak Now", r: 0.749, g: 0.589, b: 0.670, file: "data/swift/speak_now.jpg"},
  {id: "speak_now_taylors_version", title: "Speak Now (Taylor's Version)", r: 0.316, g: 0.187, b: 0.218, file: "data/swift/speak_now_taylors_version.jpg"},
  {id: "taylor_swift", title: "Taylor Swift", r: 0.532, g: 0.505, b: 0.414, file: "data/swift/taylor_swift.jpg"},
  {id: "the_tortured_poets_department", title: "The Tortured Poets Department", r: 0.794, g: 0.781, b: 0.757, file: "data/swift/the_tortured_poets_department.jpg"}
]

viewof selectedId = Inputs.select(
  albums.map(d => d.id),
  {
    label: "Choose an album:",
    format: id => albums.find(d => d.id === id).title,
    value: "folklore"
  }
)

selected = albums.find(d => d.id === selectedId)

// Compute Euclidean distance in RGB color space
others = albums
  .filter(d => d.id !== selected.id)
  .map(d => {
    const dist = Math.hypot(d.r - selected.r, d.g - selected.g, d.b - selected.b);
    return { ...d, dist };
  })
  .sort((a, b) => a.dist - b.dist)

mostSimilar = others[0]
mostDifferent = others[others.length - 1]

html`
<div class="row text-center mt-4">
  <div class="col-md-4 mb-3">
    <h5>Selected</h5>
    <p class="text-muted mb-1"><strong>${selected.title}</strong></p>
    <img src="${selected.file}" style="width: 100%; max-width: 250px; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);">
  </div>
  <div class="col-md-4 mb-3">
    <h5 style="color: #198754;">Most Similar</h5>
    <p class="text-muted mb-1"><strong>${mostSimilar.title}</strong></p>
    <img src="${mostSimilar.file}" style="width: 100%; max-width: 250px; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);">
    <p class="small text-muted mt-1">Color distance: ${mostSimilar.dist.toFixed(3)}</p>
  </div>
  <div class="col-md-4 mb-3">
    <h5 style="color: #dc3545;">Most Different</h5>
    <p class="text-muted mb-1"><strong>${mostDifferent.title}</strong></p>
    <img src="${mostDifferent.file}" style="width: 100%; max-width: 250px; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);">
    <p class="small text-muted mt-1">Color distance: ${mostDifferent.dist.toFixed(3)}</p>
  </div>
</div>
`
```
